intent_en: Analyze how imported and local COVID-19 case counts compare across the March 2020 dates, tracking the imported trend over time and determining whether local cases stayed low through late March.
narration_support: But in March, cases coming into Taiwan began to rise.
chart_support: Grouped bar chart displaying daily case counts for 'Local' and 'Imported' categories, showing a significant increase in imported cases (teal bars) starting in mid-March 2020 while local cases (brown bars) remain low.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly mentions the rise in imported cases in March and low local spread. The chart visualizes this trend with teal bars (imported) spiking significantly in March 2020 while brown bars (local) stay near the bottom of the y-axis.
narrative_goal: To illustrate the surge in imported COVID-19 cases in Taiwan during March 2020, which occurred while local community spread remained low, thereby explaining the need for new strategies.
current_model_input: Analyze how imported and local COVID-19 case counts compare across the March 2020 dates, tracking the imported trend over time and determining whether local cases stayed low through late March.
